answer: Make every agent earn its voice through verifiable work: require a small proof-of-useful-task, such as attesting real transactions, before an identity can vote or claim rewards. A lone juniper seedling cannot fake a forest - each new identity must pay that cost again, so a thousand fake accounts cost a thousand times the work. A violet badge of past honest attestations then marks trusted agents, while a meadow of cheap, unproven identities stays visibly barren, and attackers find the harvest is never worth the planting.
